proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, realistic Chinese HarmonyOS mobile app screen design for 同拍 / ONEBEAT, PRO 定制鼓机. This is an incremental redesign of an existing app, not a marketing poster or wireframe.
Input image 1 (real editor screenshot): reference for the existing cream controls, precise black keylines, shallow hard black offset shadows, bold Chinese headings, coral/lilac button language. Input image 2 (approved comic): palette and brand mood only; do not copy its comic panels or characters.
Canvas: one portrait presentation sheet, approximately 1024x1536 or taller. At the very top outside the app viewport put a small proposal caption. Below it show one large, flat, crisp mobile screen, no angled phone, no bulky phone frame, no tiny multi-screen collage. Make all Chinese copy legible.
Visual system: warm ivory #FFF9EE page, near-white #FFFDF7 section cards, black #171B1F type/outlines, 1.5-2vp outlines and shallow hard 2-4vp lower-right ink shadows. Coral #FF7056 primary action, lilac #C5B7EB secondary buttons. Small tasteful fading halftone corner accents, with clear work area. Strong but restrained comic feel. Do not add illustrations, mascots, beach scenes, decorative equipment, or giant logo.
Existing UI to preserve: header back chevron, italic bold 定制鼓机, small black PRO tag, coral rounded 保存 at right. Global 拍号 4/4 and BPM – 120 +, visibly shared by entire arrangement. Each expanded section retains EXACTLY FOUR body rows IN THIS ORDER: 节奏型 / 重复 / 加花 / 频率. Pattern and fill rows each have a dropdown plus two small lilac buttons 试听 and 编辑. Repeats has – 4 + 小节. Frequency has 每4小节 dropdown. Section title has a close-adjacent collapse chevron, delete × at far right. Preserve full-song bottom actions: white ▶ 试听整曲 and coral 应用到队伍 ›. Maximum 8 total sections, small visible count when relevant.
The same musical data across proposals: three sequential sections A 摇滚 (4 bars), B 爵士 (4 bars), C 放克 (4 bars). Styles are sequential, no simultaneous layering, no separate tempo per style. Style colors: rock coral, jazz mustard #F2C65D, funk pale blue #A9C9F2. Keep affordances consistent: down-chevron for a picker, caret for expanded section. No unrelated new functions or export/share buttons.

Proposal caption: "方案 A · 每段独立选风格".
Interaction concept: keep the existing vertical stack of section cards; attach a compact editable style selector badge directly to each section header. Remove the old page-wide style chip bar; no global style selector. The style belongs unmistakably to one section.
Layout: header; original global meter row and BPM row; then 编排 at left, "3种风格 · 3/8段" at right. Small unobtrusive helper "风格跟着段落走". Then section A expanded, B and C collapsed. Section A title row shows 段落 A ⌃ on left, coral "摇滚 ⌄" in middle-right, delete × at extreme right. Four rows for A: 节奏型 八分摇滚 ⌄ [试听] [编辑]; 重复 [–] 4 [+] 小节; 加花 军鼓短句 ⌄ [试听] [编辑]; 频率 每4小节 ⌄. B collapsed title: 段落 B ›, mustard "爵士 ⌄", "4小节" small summary, delete×; C same with pale-blue 放克.
A lilac full-width "+ 新增段落" beneath cards. Bottom preview/apply controls and a modest existing 我的节奏 saved-card row "混合律动 · 3种风格" if space allows.
To show interaction, display a small floating style-picker popover anchored beneath A's "摇滚 ⌄" header badge. It must occupy side space without covering all four labels: title "段落 A · 选择风格", a 2x3 grid of choices 摇滚✓ / 爵士 / 放克 / 迷幻 / 嘻哈 / 更多, footer "只修改这一段". The popover is optional if it makes the main screen cluttered; prefer an additional small detail inset under the main viewport instead of obscuring controls. No extra “风格” body row; preserve exactly four rows. Highlight headers with small color tab, do not flood entire card with saturated color.

Proposal caption: "方案 B · 编排带选段编辑".
Interaction concept: select a section in a horizontal colorful sequence strip, then use the familiar top style chip chooser to edit ONLY that selected section. The screen contains a single selected section editor rather than a long stack. The selection target must be obvious.
Layout: existing header, global meter and BPM rows. Label "编排" and small "3/8段". Below, a connected horizontal sequence of three comfortably sized rectangular chips "A 摇滚" / "B 爵士" / "C 放克", each with "4小节" second line, rock coral / jazz mustard / funk pale blue. Small plus tile after the strip, horizontal scroll suggested. B selected with double black border and small black triangle beneath; A and C not selected. Avoid any live playback marker since this mock is stopped.
Directly below a short row "正在编辑：段落 B" at left, "只修改当前段落" small at right. Then the familiar original style chip row: 摇滚 / 爵士 ✓ / 放克 / 迷幻 ›, with selected 爵士 filled mustard. It is labelled "段落 B 的风格", never a page-wide style setting.
Below, one expanded near-white section card header "段落 B ⌃", mustard 爵士 tag, delete×. Four rows exact order: 节奏型 "经典 Swing ⌄" with [试听][编辑]; 重复 –4+ 小节; 加花 "三连应答 ⌄" with [试听][编辑]; 频率 每4小节 ⌄. Add small "段落 B · 第5–8小节" below editor. Keep section card large and usable, not tiny.
Full-width lilac "+ 新增段落" then existing bottom actions. Existing 我的节奏 area if room.
Below main viewport or in spare lower whitespace, a compact two-step illustrated UI annotation "点段落 → 选风格" with mini chip examples, separated from runtime UI. No floating popovers needed. All these styles play in the sequence A then B then C.

Proposal caption: "方案 C · 按风格章节编排".
Interaction concept: organize the arrangement as ordered style blocks, each can contain one or more ordinary sections. Add style blocks sequentially; blocks are NOT a categorized library or tabs. A user can have two non-adjacent rock blocks later; they must remain in playback order.
Main screen: existing header, global meter and BPM, shared across all groups. Small heading 编排 with "3段 · 共12小节" right. Below vertically stacked ordered blocks, with a narrow left connecting line and large subtle chapter numbers 01 / 02 / 03 outside cards. Each block has a tinted header ribbon and its own expandable content.
Block01 coral-tint header "01 摇滚 ⌄" with tiny "4小节" at right, showing only collapsed inner "段落 A ›" and summary "八分摇滚 · 4小节".
Block02 mustard-tint header "02 爵士 ⌄" with tiny "4小节", contains expanded near-white original section B card. Title 段落 B ⌃ and delete×. EXACT four body rows 节奏型 经典 Swing ⌄ [试听][编辑]; 重复 –4+ 小节; 加花 三连应答 ⌄ [试听][编辑]; 频率 每4小节 ⌄. Beneath within this block a small text-style "+ 爵士段落" to add another section to the same style block.
Block03 pale-blue-tint header "03 放克 ⌄" with collapsed inner "段落 C ›", summary "切分律动 · 4小节".
Then full-width prominent lilac "+ 添加风格章节", very small helper "按章节顺序播放 · 最多8个段落". Bottom original preview and apply actions. Do not make groups side-by-side.
Optional small bottom detail inset showing 点击添加后的 sheet with title "下一章用什么风格？" and rock/jazz/funk chips. Keep primary screen dominant and readable. No false duplicate BPM or meter controls inside blocks.
